pattern: Labelled region of items with a toggle-button move handle per item (keyboard drag-and-drop pattern, as Sortable List) and live-region announcements. No ARIA drag-and-drop attributes (aria-grabbed and aria-dropeffect are deprecated). The catalog is a labelled list of buttons.

roles.role: unchanged (owned by the page; for example a Dashboard Widget region)

aria.value: Localized 'Move {label}': the item's `label`, else its first heading (h1-h6 or role=heading) text, else its id
true while the item is grabbed (keyboard) or dragged/resized (pointer), false otherwise
Localized 'Add {label}' (the description is visible text only)
Assertive: grabbed (with position, size, and instructions), moved, resized, dropped, cancelled. Polite: added, removed, undone, redone, locked.

keyboard.action: Moves through the move handles and item content in DOM order, which follows the visual reading order (row, then column).

Grabs the item (aria-pressed=true); announces '{label} grabbed. Column {column}, row {row}, {width} by {height}. Arrow keys move, Shift and arrow keys resize, Enter drops, Escape cancels.' A locked item announces '{label} is locked.' and is not grabbed.
Moves the item one cell (Left/Right mirrored in RTL); other items are pushed down and float up live; announces 'Column {column}, row {row}.' Stops at the grid edges.
Widens / narrows the item by one column (in both directions), within minW/maxW and the column count; announces '{width} columns by {height} rows.'
Makes the item one row taller / shorter, within minH/maxH; announces the size.
Drops the item (compacting the layout); announces '{label} dropped at column {column}, row {row}.'; emits aui-layout-change (move or resize) when the layout changed. Focus stays on the handle.
Cancels: the layout returns to where it was; announces 'Move cancelled. {label} is back at column {column}, row {row}.' The key event is consumed (preventDefault and stopPropagation).
Drops the item at its current position (like Enter) and moves focus on. Leaving the handle any other way (blur) also drops.

keyboard.context: Edit mode, focus inside the grid, nothing grabbed
keyboard.action: Undo the last layout change (moves, resizes, setLayout); announces 'Layout change undone.'

keyboard.context: Edit mode, focus inside the grid, nothing grabbed

keyboard.action: Adds the widget at the first free spot (after the cancelable aui-catalog-add); in edit mode focus moves to the new item's move handle.
Moves between template buttons (each is a tab stop).

focus: Focus stays on the grabbed item's move handle during a keyboard move and after the drop; DOM reordering to reading order restores focus to the previously focused element (preventScroll). After a catalog add in edit mode, focus moves to the new item's move handle. The handle shows a focus-ring-width outline in color-focus-ring.
notes: Dragging is never the only way to move or resize (WCAG 2.5.7): the move handle works with keyboard and with a single pointer (click the handle to grab, click again to drop); Shift+arrow keys resize.
The DOM order follows the visual reading order after every change (reorderDom, default true), so focus order and screen-reader reading order match the layout.
The grabbed state is conveyed by aria-pressed, a selected background, and a border (not color alone); forced-colors mode uses Highlight.
Handles, grips, and catalog buttons are at least touch-target-min in size.
Undo/redo shortcuts apply only in edit mode and not while an item is grabbed.
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
Some screen readers intercept Space, Enter, and arrow keys in browse mode; users may need focus/forms mode on the handle.
Pointer drags and pointer resizes are not announced.
In edit mode the undo/redo shortcuts are handled on the whole host, so they also apply (and prevent native undo) while a text field inside a widget is focused.
